data.title: 小鞠知花 · 图书馆顶层书架的踮脚惊呼
data.description: 安静高大的红木图书馆过道尽头，尘埃在阳光光柱中漂浮。小鞠踮着小脚尖使劲伸长手臂去够最顶层的大部头小说，重心不稳向后歪倒，惊慌失措瞪大双眼。
data.location: quiet high-ceilinged school library aisle lined with towering polished oak bookshelves
data.action: standing on tiptoes with arms stretched high toward a top book, wobbling off-balance, wide startled teary eyes in helpless panic
data.lighting: 高拱窗透入的书架丁达尔灰尘光束
data.promptProse: Chika Komari stretches precariously on tiptoes for a high library book, wobbling backward with wide panicked eyes in the sunlit aisle.
data.animaCaption: Sunlight filtering through library shelves catches her trembling hands reaching for the top book.
